title: DOW-UAP-D12, Mission Report, Iraq, May 2022
doc_notes: This document is a declassified U.S. military Mission Report (MISREP) from May 2022 detailing a UAP observation in Iraq, featuring heavy redactions under 1.4(a) and other exemptions.

incidents.summary: A U.S. military operator observed one UAP flying north to northeast and followed it as long as possible but could not identify it.
incidents.quote: OBSERVED A UAP AT 2043Z FLY NORTH TO NORTH EAST AND FOLLOWED AS LONG AS POSSIBLE.
